task.title: Packetize Persona Management and Remaining Catalog drilldowns
task.summary_zh: 把 Persona Management 與 remaining catalog drilldowns 整理成 Persona Workbench packet set。
acceptance: persona management is promoted from a sidecar handoff into a canonical screen packet
remaining catalog endpoints are grouped into explicit drilldown modules instead of a vague catch-all
Lovable readiness and missing screen-spec work are listed per module
task.next: Owner finalized approved Persona Workbench packet backlog; Wave 1 and Wave 2 module inventory is checkpointed and archived.
review_notes_zh: 審查通過：persona management 已從 sidecar handoff 升格為 canonical screen packet（GET /api/v1/operator/persona-management/{persona_id}），role-gating 與 allowedActions 語義完整。
審查通過：33 個 remaining catalog surfaces 已分組為六個明確模組 A–F，無模糊 catch-all；每個模組均有逐條 endpoint 列表。
審查通過：Module A 列出全部 PS-01..PS-06，並明確標注 persona list shell 與 detail shell packet language 仍缺失。
審查通過：Wave 1/Wave 2 分類清晰；Tool profile、Consult policy 與 persona list/detail shell 均列為 Wave 2 deferred。
審查通過：非阻塞 BFF caveats 均保留（snapshot 未強制、time_range filter deferrals、lineage root_type no-op）。
審查通過：未重複定義 PKT-001/PKT-002/PKT-003 所屬的 composed views，只在 Module C/F 加上 shared 參照。

delivery.commit_subject: PKT-004: finalize Persona Workbench packet backlog

handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Codex while Claude completes higher-priority work.

Updated Persona Workbench packetization in the backlog: promoted persona management into a canonical packet, split remaining catalog into explicit Modules A-F, and separated per-module readiness, screen-spec gaps, and backend dependencies for review.
All six reviewer gates passed; backlog artifact meets AC-1 through AC-3. Approved and returned to owner for finalization.
